necessity_paragraph: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of palpitations and irregular heart rhythm consistent with paroxysmal atrial fibrillation, corresponding to diagnosis code I48.0. Given the personal history of transient ischemic attack and cerebral infarction, continuous mobile cardiac telemetry (CPT 93229) is ordered to detect asymptomatic arrhythmias and optimize anticoagulation management. This clinical indication supports the medical necessity of the service despite the missing prior authorization.
